mapper.select: SELECT c.comment_id AS commentId, c.post_id AS postId, c.user_id AS userId, c.content AS content, c.create_time AS createTime, u.username AS authorName FROM community_comment c LEFT JOIN `user` u ON c.user_id = u.user_id WHERE c.post_id = #{postId} ORDER BY c.create_time ASC, c.comment_id ASC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO community_comment (post_id, user_id, content) VALUES (#{postId}, #{userId}, #{content})
